kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the cascade roster; the USMLE question attack structure is a KYP design.
kypExtensions.location: usmle section (patterns, traps, pivots, miniCase) + recall/rapidReview

kypExtensions.summary: Mapping fragment failures to disease: terminal C5-C9 → recurrent Neisseria (normal opsonization); C3 → pyogenic + immune-complex disease; early classical → immune-complex syndromes; properdin (X-linked) → Neisseria; C1-INH → hereditary angioedema (bradykinin, no urticaria, low C4, trauma triggers); DAF/CD55 (+CD59) loss → PNH. Plus the CH50-vs-AH50 localization logic. The printed page names only the two inhibitors and the Neisseria sentence; the disease genetics, AH50, and therapy specifics are labeled KYP extension.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source presents components and inhibitors without the deficiency-to-disease map or assay-differentiation logic; these integrations are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + mechanism 2 caption + callout + patterns 1-3 + pivots + miniCase

notes: Census: pdfimages -list on p126 returns ZERO images — the cascade diagram is pure vector; one original KYP registry visual (complement-cascade-map) redraws its topology (three doors, convertases, fragment outputs, anaphylaxis rail, opsonization panel, inhibitor strip).
